articles.title: What Capitec Shareholders Got Right
articles.summary: Capitec’s latest half year update put hard numbers behind its digital push, with H1 2027 revenue of ZAR 23,090m and net income of ZAR 9,523m on the record. For Capitec shareholders, the return over the past year was 24.2%, including dividends. If you were weighing a purchase back in November 2025, what beliefs about digital banking and earnings power would have informed your view before those results arrived?
